run.name: 04-explainer-3beat
run.finalText:
Building is done. I'm now checking the motion on a contact sheet.
I've built the 12-second scene in the Main comp. I checked it on a contact sheet at ten timestamps. I haven't played it back in real time, so the jitter and the sucking-in motion are unchecked.

- **Beat 1 (0–4s):** Six sticky notes in yellow, pink, mint, orange, blue and lilac pop in one after another, each with a different password. They jitter through 4s using a rotation-wiggle expression. I haven't confirmed that expression produces visible jitter. The shield fades in behind the pile from 3.2s, so there's no cut.
- **Beat 2 (4–7s):** The notes spin and shrink into the shield one after another. The shield pulses each time one lands, then does a final lock-in squash at about 6.5s.
- **Beat 3 (6.4–12s):** A flat cyan glow disc blooms behind the shield, which rises slightly as the glow grows. "One key. Every login." slides up at 7.5s. A white check mark then draws itself onto the shield at 8.2s. The glow pulses gently until the end.

Beat 3 starts earlier than a strict 4s split (about 6.4s rather than 8s), so the lock-in doesn't sit idle.

At 5.4s a small white fragment shows near the shield. I think it's note text mid-suck, but I didn't confirm it isn't the check mark.

I can make the beats an even 4s each, or give the glow a soft gradient instead of the flat disc.

items.text: jitter/anxious motion (wiggle expression or many small keys)
